extracted.name: Egg in a Hole
extracted.description: Egg in a hole makes a hearty breakfast that’s ready to eat in 5 minutes. A runny yolk egg cooked in the center of a piece of toast… Delicious!
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Melt bacon grease in a nonstick pan over low heat.

Cut a 2-inch hole in the center of bread slice; place in the hot skillet and cook until lightly toasted, about 2 minutes. Flip bread and crack egg into the hole; season with salt and pepper. Continue to cook until egg is cooked and mostly firm; flip again and cook 1 minute more. Serve immediately.
